text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text:
I heard that you took on the starting gate 
you struggle with during your previous 
training session, my liege.

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you a good child? Allow me to grant 
you a reward. What would you like?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
!! A reward!? Does that mean... anything I 
want?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Like a sparkly staff covered in magic 
stones... or rare animal familiars... or a 
gigantic mansion floating in the sky...!"

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text:
"Very well. I shall arrange everything. I 
will let So-chan know."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...I see through you now! You're... an 
evil witch, aren't you?! You're trying to 
trap me!"

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text: Oh? Whatever made you think that?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Because, isn't it weird?! Sure, I'm 
amazing and all, but suddenly praising me 
and giving me a reward out of nowhere?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...That's it! You're trying to lure me 
with treats and turn me into a Darkness 
Witch! I just know it...!"

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text:
"My, my... Hohoho, well then... If that is 
your wish, allow me to reveal my true 
identity."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
*Gasp*!! I-I knew it...! Wait right there, 
I'll go fetch a cane!

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text:
Ho ho ho ho... Such a darling little 
thing.
